phase: independent preimplementation observations; before reading other lanes findings or patches

observations.finding: Three independently validated single-file save formats share an unsafe commit: Setup.write_named, Generated.write_named and architectural save_project use DirAccess.rename_absolute after flush. Pinned Godot Windows implementation removes an existing destination before MoveFileW and can lose the only old file if the latter fails. This is independently source confirmed; OS data-loss reproduction pending.

All three callers assume file.get_error after flush and close establishes complete written content. Pinned Unix and Windows FileAccess.flush ignores fflush return, close discards fclose return, and last_error is only refreshed during store/read. A short buffered write can therefore need post-close byte verification. Reproduction pending.

Generated/project failure copy overstates atomic replacement or old-file preservation despite the unsafe primitive. Existing tests only reject invalid payloads before I/O and do not reach rename or buffered flush failures.

The accepted native material-baseline replace API checks absolute same-directory paths, distinct file identities and regular non-link endpoints; it has no format or extension restriction. Reusing it does not require a new native ABI. Material-baseline writer and native implementation should remain unchanged; strengthened small-JSON staging/readback belongs in a shared GDScript helper.

initial_contract: One closed, verified staging file committed through the existing native same-volume replacement. Existing file must not be deleted on unsuccessful replacement. Old formats and main-thread synchronous operation remain. Atomic visibility and ordinary process/write failure safety are separate from fsync/power-loss durability; no latter claim.
